messages:
Alex R: Heads-up p95 on prod inference just spiked to ~750ms in us-west-2, started ~12:03 UTC. Throughput down ~30%.
Maria L: seeing same in console. Kernel-selection jitter around 12:02 from scheduler — lots of kernel switches :eyes:
Tariq: GPU util for tenant-alpha is 98%, queues building up and streaming frames getting backpressured.
infra-bot: KV cache eviction rate = 4.2x baseline; cache hit dropped 92% -> 61%.
Sophie: any deploys around then? I see a rollout at 11:59 with commit 3f7a9c5 (scheduler heuristic tweak).
Alex R: that commit tweaked the kernel selection threshold for long sequences to prefer fp16-kernel-a. Could be mispredicting for streaming + tool-loop patterns.
Maria L: digging traces now — tail latencies line up with a prompt-length spike. median prompt len jumped to ~3200 tokens and many requests have ongoing tool calls.
Tariq: initial hypothesis: new heuristic moves some requests to a kernel that increases KV pressure (longer KV lifetimes), causing cross-tenant thrash.
Sophie: can we rollback the heuristic fast?
Alex R: I'll roll it back.
deploy-bot: initiating rollback to scheduler@3f7a9c2 (previous stable)
Maria L: while rollback runs, can we throttle tenant-alpha or move it to a fallback pool? It's the noisy neighbor.
Tariq: bumped tenant-alpha to low-priority routing and directed new sessions to a quantized fallback model.
Alex R: rollback completed — observing p95 back down to ~95ms after ~2 minutes, throughput recovering steadily.
infra-bot: KV eviction rate now 1.1x baseline, cache hit recovering.
Sophie: we'll need a short postmortem: CI should include streaming+toolcall scenarios for scheduler heuristics.
Alex R: action items: 1) confirm rollback stability, 2) add regression tests with long streaming sequences and tool-calls, 3) add alert for KV-eviction-ratio > 2x and sudden kernel-selection distribution shifts.
Maria L: dumping traces and perf profiles to s3://redwood-perf/1781234567/traces for PM/ENG-ML review.
Tariq: proposal: implement per-tenant small LRU shard for KV so one noisy tenant can't evict everything.
Alex R: agreed, add design doc and spike task. Great catch everyone :raised_hands:
infra-bot: incident closed — timeline and artifacts uploaded to the perf bucket.
